# `aitbc edge database init-db`

Initialize a new edge database on an island.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge database init-db [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--database-id` | text | — | yes | The Database id. |
| `--island-id` | text | — | yes | The Island id. |
| `--capacity-gb` | integer | — | yes | The Capacity gb. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge database init-db --database-id <database_id> --island-id <island_id> --capacity-gb <capacity_gb>
```
